newsitem.title: USA: Conrail to review new Norfolk bid.
newsitem.headline: Conrail to review new Norfolk bid.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it will promptly review an increased takeover offer from Norfolk Southern Corp, but also noted its board previously had determined a merger with CSX Corp was in its best interests.
The railroad also advised shareholders to await the response of the Conrail board and not to take any action with respect to the new Norfolk Southern bid.
Norfolk Southern earlier raised its unsolicited cash bid for Conrail to $10 billion from $9.1 billion.
Conrail has agreed to a transaction with CSX in a deal valued at about $8.5 billion.
